Proposition
[Universal property of the free product]

↗ def:free-product-of-groups

\group Fundamental Group

Homomorphisms $\varphi _\alpha :G_\alpha \to H$ extend uniquely to $\varphi :*_\alpha G_\alpha \to H$ by $\varphi (g_1\cdots g_m)=\prod _i\varphi _{\alpha _i}(g_i)$.
